'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Joseph Graham LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014806/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
